name: Should I paint my garage myself or hire a professional contractor?

mainEntity.name: Should I paint my garage myself or hire a professional contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: DIY garage painting saves upfront labor costs, but hiring a professional ensures proper surface prep, seamless drywall repairs, and durable paint adhesion. Garages often have high ceilings, bare sheetrock seams, settling cracks, and moisture stains that require skilled taping, patching, and priming. Owner-operated contractors like Abraham Becerra at HH Remodeling LLC handle everything from minor framing and drywall finishing to spray application, eliminating the physical strain, ladder hazards, and specialized tool purchases required to achieve a clean, professional finish on your own.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hiring a pro saves time, handles high ceilings safely, and ensures critical surface repairs like tape-and-mud patching are done correctly before painting.
